article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — KJ Younger had 24 points nine rebounds as UNC Greensboro beat Chattanooga 77-72 on Thursday. Justin Neely made 5 of 8 from the field and finished with 17 points and 11 rebounds for the Spartans (5-9, 1-0 Southern Conference). Donald Whitehead Jr. shot 4 of 9 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. The Mocs (6-8, 0-1) were led in scoring by Jikari Johnson, who finished with 15 points and six rebounds. Chattanooga also got 12 points apiece from Collin Mulholland and Brennan Watkins. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
